_docs.workspace_root_is_plain_folder: Always true for this runtime: the workspace root is a plain folder that groups member repositories as siblings. It is not a git parent and must never use submodules. Orca may label that folder 'not a valid worktree folder'; that is expected for a folder project, not an error.
_docs.master_seat: Where the master session sits: usually the folder workspace of the workspace root (selector form id:folder:<uuid>), or the primary worktree when the whole workspace is one repository.
_docs.repositories: Inventory of member repositories the master coordinates. Paths are relative to the workspace root. role is product or ops. capabilities names what worker lanes may do (for example pr, dispatch-target). prohibited names hard stops (for example direct-main-commit, force-push).
_docs.name: Short stable id for the repository entry (usually the folder basename).
_docs.path: Workspace-root-relative path to the checkout (for example product-app or workspace-ops).
_docs.remote: Canonical remote URL when known; use empty string when none is measured yet.
_docs.role: product for code the master coordinates through workers; ops for the workspace governance repository.
_docs.capabilities: Allowed worker-lane actions for this repository (open set; common values: pr, dispatch-target).
_docs.prohibited: Hard-blocked actions for this repository (open set; common values: direct-main-commit, force-push).
